W.note: Pastel aurora glow blooms and spins behind a frosted pill with soft long curves and a lovely leave, though the rest state is low-contrast and the blur layer is costlier.

X.note: Luminous rim and cloud glow on a dark pill with 700-1500ms long-tail curves, strong focus ring, calm-mode toggle, reduced-motion handling and full realistic page context.

Y.note: Very slow 1.2-1.8s transitions but the visible change is faint, so the hover barely reads as dreamy; clean, accessible and well typeset.

Z.note: Bright gradient button with a drifting white-haze bloom that is pretty and legible, but the hover hits the label with haze and reduced-motion is only a duration cut.
